# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # If the branch of a conditional consists solely of a conditional node,
      # its conditions can be combined with the conditions of the outer branch.
      # This helps to keep the nesting level from getting too deep.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     if condition_b
      #       do_something
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a && condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: false (default)
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: true
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      class SoleNestedConditional < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Consider merging nested conditions into outer `%<conditional_type>s` conditions.'

        def self.autocorrect_incompatible_with
          [Style::NegatedIf, Style::NegatedUnless]
        end

        def on_if(node)
          return if node.ternary? || node.else? || node.elsif?

          if_branch = node.if_branch
          return if use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(node.condition, if_branch)
          return unless offending_branch?(node, if_branch)

          message = format(MSG, conditional_type: node.keyword)
          add_offense(if_branch.loc.keyword, message: message) do |corrector|
            autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        private

        def use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(condition, if_branch)
          assigned_variables = assigned_variables(condition)

          assigned_variables && if_branch&.if_type? &&
            assigned_variables.include?(if_branch.condition.source)
        end

        def assigned_variables(condition)
          assigned_variables = condition.assignment? ? [condition.children.first.to_s] : []

          assigned_variables + condition.descendants.select(&:assignment?).map do |node|
            node.children.first.to_s
          end
        end

        def offending_branch?(node, branch)
          return false unless branch

          branch.if_type? &&
            !branch.else? &&
            !branch.ternary? &&
            !((node.modifier_form? || branch.modifier_form?) && allow_modifier?)
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          if node.condition.or_type? || node.condition.assignment?
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '(', ')')
          end

          if outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
            autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          else
            autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node) if node.unless?

          outer_condition = node.condition
          correct_outer_condition(corrector, outer_condition)

          and_operator = if_branch.unless? ? ' && !' : ' && '
          if if_branch.modifier_form?
            correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          else
            correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
            correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, if_branch, is_modify_form: true) if if_branch.unless?
          correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
        end

        def correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node, is_modify_form: false)
          corrector.replace(node.loc.keyword, 'if')

          insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
        end

        def correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_after(outer_condition, "#{and_operator}#{replace_condition(condition)}")

          range = range_between(if_branch.loc.keyword.begin_pos, condition.source_range.end_pos)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(range, newlines: false))
          corrector.remove(if_branch.loc.keyword)
        end

        def correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
          range = range_between(
            node.condition.source_range.end_pos, if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
          )
          corrector.replace(range, and_operator)
          corrector.remove(range_by_whole_lines(node.loc.end, include_final_newline: true))

          wrap_condition(corrector, if_branch.condition)
        end

        def wrap_condition(corrector, condition)
          # Handle `send` and `block` nodes that need to be wrapped in parens
          # FIXME: autocorrection prevents syntax errors by wrapping the entire node in parens,
          #        but wrapping the argument list would be a more ergonomic correction.
          node_to_check = condition&.block_type? ? condition.send_node : condition
          return unless wrap_condition?(node_to_check)

          if condition.call_type?
            source = parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)

            corrector.replace(condition, source)
          else
            corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')
          end
        end

        def correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_before(condition,
                                  "#{'!' if node.unless?}#{replace_condition(node.condition)} && ")

          corrector.remove(node.condition)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(node.loc.keyword, newlines: false))
          corrector.replace(if_branch.loc.keyword, 'if')
        end

        def correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          comments = processed_source.ast_with_comments[if_branch].select do |comment|
            comment.loc.line < if_branch.condition.first_line
          end
          comment_text = comments.map(&:text).join("\n") << "\n"

          corrector.insert_before(node.loc.keyword, comment_text) unless comments.empty?
        end

        def correct_outer_condition(corrector, condition)
          return unless require_parentheses?(condition)

          end_pos = condition.loc.selector.end_pos
          begin_pos = condition.first_argument.source_range.begin_pos
          return if end_pos > begin_pos

          range = range_between(end_pos, begin_pos)
          corrector.remove(range)
          corrector.insert_after(range, '(')
          corrector.insert_after(condition.last_argument, ')')
        end

        def insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
          condition = node.condition

          if (condition.send_type? && condition.comparison_method? && !condition.parenthesized?) ||
             (is_modify_form && wrap_condition?(condition))
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '!(', ')')
          elsif condition.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          else
            corrector.insert_before(condition, '!')
          end
        end

        def insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          lhs, rhs = *node # rubocop:disable InternalAffairs/NodeDestructuring

          if lhs.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, lhs)
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!') if rhs
          else
            corrector.insert_before(lhs, '!')
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!')
          end
        end

        def require_parentheses?(condition)
          condition.call_type? && !condition.arguments.empty? && !condition.parenthesized? &&
            !condition.comparison_method?
        end

        def arguments_range(node)
          range_between(
            node.first_argument.source_range.begin_pos, node.last_argument.source_range.end_pos
          )
        end

        def wrap_condition?(node)
          node.operator_keyword? || (node.call_type? && node.arguments.any? && !node.parenthesized?)
        end

        def replace_condition(condition)
          source = condition.source
          condition_range = condition.source_range
          return source unless condition_range

          begin_pos = condition_range.begin_pos
          end_pos = condition_range.end_pos
          return source if end_pos <= begin_pos

          requires_wrap = false
          loc = condition.loc
          buffer_source = condition_range.source_buffer.source
          shape_facts = [
            condition_range.first_line,
            condition_range.last_line,
            condition_range.column,
            condition_range.last_column,
            end_pos - begin_pos,
            condition_range.last_line != condition_range.first_line
          ]
          requires_wrap = true if shape_facts.length.zero?

          if condition.operator_keyword?
            requires_wrap = true
            pending = [condition]
            seen = {}
            until pending.empty?
              current = pending.shift
              next if current.nil?
              next if seen[current.object_id]

              seen[current.object_id] = true
              current_range = current.source_range
              current_facts = [
                current.source, current_range.begin_pos, current_range.end_pos,
                current_range.first_line, current_range.column, current_range.last_line,
                current.type, current.children,
                current_range.end_pos - current_range.begin_pos,
                current_range.last_line != current_range.first_line
              ]
              next if current_facts.length.zero?

              if current.operator_keyword?
                lhs = current.lhs
                rhs = current.rhs
                operator_text = current.loc.operator.source
                requires_wrap = true if operator_text
                if lhs
                  lhs_range = lhs.source_range
                  lhs_facts = [
                    lhs.source, lhs.type, lhs_range.begin_pos, lhs_range.end_pos,
                    lhs_range.first_line, lhs_range.column, lhs_range.last_line, lhs.children,
                    lhs_range.end_pos - lhs_range.begin_pos,
                    lhs_range.last_line != lhs_range.first_line
                  ]
                  requires_wrap = true if lhs_facts.any?
                  if lhs.begin_type?
                    inner = lhs.children.first
                    if inner
                      inner_range = inner.source_range
                      inner_facts = [
                        inner.source,
                        inner.type,
                        inner_range.begin_pos,
                        inner_range.end_pos,
                        inner_range.first_line,
                        inner_range.end_pos - inner_range.begin_pos,
                        lhs.children.size
                      ]
                      pending << inner if inner_facts.any?
                    else
                      pending << lhs
                    end
                  else
                    pending << lhs
                  end
                end
                if rhs
                  rhs_range = rhs.source_range
                  rhs_facts = [
                    rhs.source, rhs.type, rhs_range.begin_pos, rhs_range.end_pos,
                    rhs_range.first_line, rhs_range.column, rhs_range.last_line, rhs.children,
                    rhs_range.end_pos - rhs_range.begin_pos,
                    rhs_range.last_line != rhs_range.first_line
                  ]
                  requires_wrap = true if rhs_facts.any?
                  if rhs.begin_type?
                    inner = rhs.children.first
                    if inner
                      inner_range = inner.source_range
                      inner_facts = [
                        inner.source,
                        inner.type,
                        inner_range.begin_pos,
                        inner_range.end_pos,
                        inner_range.first_line,
                        inner_range.end_pos - inner_range.begin_pos,
                        rhs.children.size
                      ]
                      pending << inner if inner_facts.any?
                    else
                      pending << rhs
                    end
                  else
                    pending << rhs
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          elsif condition.call_type?
            call_args = condition.arguments
            receiver = condition.receiver
            selector = loc.selector
            selector_source = selector.source
            first_argument = call_args.first
            last_argument = call_args.last
            parenthesized_call = condition.parenthesized?
            call_facts = [
              condition.method_name,
              selector_source,
              call_args.length,
              condition.operator_method?,
              selector_source.end_with?('?'),
              selector_source.end_with?('!')
            ]
            if call_args.empty?
              requires_wrap = false
            elsif parenthesized_call
              requires_wrap = false
            else
              requires_wrap = true
              first_argument_range = first_argument.source_range
              last_argument_range = last_argument.source_range
              first_argument_begin = first_argument_range.begin_pos
              last_argument_end = last_argument_range.end_pos
              selector_end_pos = selector.end_pos
              argument_facts = [
                first_argument_range.end_pos,
                last_argument_range.begin_pos,
                first_argument_range.first_line,
                last_argument_range.last_line,
                first_argument_range.column,
                last_argument_range.last_column,
                last_argument_end - first_argument_begin,
                first_argument_begin - selector_end_pos,
                buffer_source[begin_pos...selector_end_pos],
                buffer_source[first_argument_begin...end_pos],
                call_facts
              ]
              requires_wrap = true if argument_facts.any?
              if receiver
                receiver_range = receiver.source_range
                receiver_facts = [
                  receiver.source,
                  receiver.type,
                  receiver_range.begin_pos,
                  receiver_range.end_pos,
                  receiver_range.first_line,
                  receiver_range.column,
                  receiver_range.last_line,
                  receiver_range.end_pos - receiver_range.begin_pos,
                  receiver_range.last_line != receiver_range.first_line,
                  receiver.children
                ]
                requires_wrap = true if receiver_facts.any?
                if receiver.call_type?
                  nested_receiver_args = receiver.arguments
                  nested_receiver_facts = [
                    nested_receiver_args.length,
                    receiver.parenthesized?,
                    receiver.method_name,
                    receiver.loc.selector.source,
                    receiver.operator_method?
                  ]
                  if nested_receiver_args.length > 0
                    requires_wrap = true
                  elsif nested_receiver_facts.any?
                    requires_wrap = true
                  end
                end
              end
              call_args.each do |argument|
                next unless argument

                argument_range = argument.source_range
                argument_children = argument.children
                argument_facts = [
                  argument.source, argument_range.begin_pos, argument_range.end_pos,
                  argument_range.first_line, argument_range.last_line, argument_range.column,
                  argument_range.last_column, argument_range.end_pos - argument_range.begin_pos,
                  argument_range.last_line != argument_range.first_line, argument.type,
                  argument_children, argument_children[0], argument_children[-1],
                  argument_children.length, argument.operator_keyword?, argument.begin_type?,
                  argument.hash_type?, argument.array_type?, argument.splat_type?,
                  argument.const_type?, argument.variable?
                ]
                requires_wrap = true if argument_facts.any?
                if argument.call_type?
                  nested_args = argument.arguments
                  nested_facts = [
                    nested_args.length,
                    argument.method_name,
                    argument.loc.selector.source,
                    argument.parenthesized?,
                    argument.operator_method?,
                    nested_args.first,
                    nested_args.last
                  ]
                  if nested_args.length > 0
                    requires_wrap = true
                  elsif nested_facts.any?
                    requires_wrap = true
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          else
            requires_wrap = false
          end

          return source unless requires_wrap

          if condition.call_type?
            call_node = ParenthesesCorrector.normalized_condition_node(condition)
            selector_end = call_node.loc.selector.end
            method_call = call_node.source_range.begin.join(selector_end).source
            arguments_source = call_node.first_argument.source_range.begin.join(call_node.source_range.end).source
            "#{method_call}(#{arguments_source})"
          else
            "(#{source})"
          end
        end

        def parenthesized_method_arguments(node)
          method_call = node.source_range.begin.join(node.loc.selector.end).source
          arguments = node.first_argument.source_range.begin.join(node.source_range.end).source

          "#{method_call}(#{arguments})"
        end

        def allow_modifier?
          cop_config['AllowModifier']
        end

        def outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
          node.condition.source_range.begin_pos > if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # If the branch of a conditional consists solely of a conditional node,
      # its conditions can be combined with the conditions of the outer branch.
      # This helps to keep the nesting level from getting too deep.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     if condition_b
      #       do_something
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a && condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: false (default)
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: true
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      class SoleNestedConditional < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Consider merging nested conditions into outer `%<conditional_type>s` conditions.'

        def self.autocorrect_incompatible_with
          [Style::NegatedIf, Style::NegatedUnless]
        end

        def on_if(node)
          return if node.ternary? || node.else? || node.elsif?

          if_branch = node.if_branch
          return if use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(node.condition, if_branch)
          return unless offending_branch?(node, if_branch)

          message = format(MSG, conditional_type: node.keyword)
          add_offense(if_branch.loc.keyword, message: message) do |corrector|
            autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        private

        def use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(condition, if_branch)
          assigned_variables = assigned_variables(condition)

          assigned_variables && if_branch&.if_type? &&
            assigned_variables.include?(if_branch.condition.source)
        end

        def assigned_variables(condition)
          assigned_variables = condition.assignment? ? [condition.children.first.to_s] : []

          assigned_variables + condition.descendants.select(&:assignment?).map do |node|
            node.children.first.to_s
          end
        end

        def offending_branch?(node, branch)
          return false unless branch

          branch.if_type? &&
            !branch.else? &&
            !branch.ternary? &&
            !((node.modifier_form? || branch.modifier_form?) && allow_modifier?)
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          if node.condition.or_type? || node.condition.assignment?
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '(', ')')
          end

          if outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
            autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          else
            autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node) if node.unless?

          outer_condition = node.condition
          correct_outer_condition(corrector, outer_condition)

          and_operator = if_branch.unless? ? ' && !' : ' && '
          if if_branch.modifier_form?
            correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          else
            correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
            correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, if_branch, is_modify_form: true) if if_branch.unless?
          correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
        end

        def correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node, is_modify_form: false)
          corrector.replace(node.loc.keyword, 'if')

          insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
        end

        def correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_after(outer_condition, "#{and_operator}#{replace_condition(condition)}")

          range = range_between(if_branch.loc.keyword.begin_pos, condition.source_range.end_pos)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(range, newlines: false))
          corrector.remove(if_branch.loc.keyword)
        end

        def correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
          range = range_between(
            node.condition.source_range.end_pos, if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
          )
          corrector.replace(range, and_operator)
          corrector.remove(range_by_whole_lines(node.loc.end, include_final_newline: true))

          wrap_condition(corrector, if_branch.condition)
        end

        def wrap_condition(corrector, condition)
          # Handle `send` and `block` nodes that need to be wrapped in parens
          # FIXME: autocorrection prevents syntax errors by wrapping the entire node in parens,
          #        but wrapping the argument list would be a more ergonomic correction.
          node_to_check = condition&.any_block_type? ? condition.send_node : condition
          return unless wrap_condition?(node_to_check)

          if condition.call_type?
            source = parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)

            corrector.replace(condition, source)
          else
            corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')
          end
        end

        def correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_before(condition,
                                  "#{'!' if node.unless?}#{replace_condition(node.condition)} && ")

          corrector.remove(node.condition)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(node.loc.keyword, newlines: false))
          corrector.replace(if_branch.loc.keyword, 'if')
        end

        def correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          comments = processed_source.ast_with_comments[if_branch].select do |comment|
            comment.loc.line < if_branch.condition.first_line
          end
          comment_text = comments.map(&:text).join("\n") << "\n"

          corrector.insert_before(node.loc.keyword, comment_text) unless comments.empty?
        end

        def correct_outer_condition(corrector, condition)
          return unless require_parentheses?(condition)

          end_pos = condition.loc.selector.end_pos
          begin_pos = condition.first_argument.source_range.begin_pos
          return if end_pos > begin_pos

          range = range_between(end_pos, begin_pos)
          corrector.remove(range)
          corrector.insert_after(range, '(')
          corrector.insert_after(condition.last_argument, ')')
        end

        def insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
          condition = node.condition

          if (condition.send_type? && condition.comparison_method? && !condition.parenthesized?) ||
             (is_modify_form && wrap_condition?(condition))
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '!(', ')')
          elsif condition.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          else
            corrector.insert_before(condition, '!')
          end
        end

        def insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          lhs, rhs = *node # rubocop:disable InternalAffairs/NodeDestructuring

          if lhs.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, lhs)
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!') if rhs
          else
            corrector.insert_before(lhs, '!')
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!')
          end
        end

        def require_parentheses?(condition)
          condition.call_type? && !condition.arguments.empty? && !condition.parenthesized? &&
            !condition.comparison_method?
        end

        def wrap_condition?(node)
          node.operator_keyword? || (node.call_type? && node.arguments.any? && !node.parenthesized?)
        end

        def replace_condition(condition)
          return condition.source unless wrap_condition?(condition)

          if condition.call_type? && !condition.comparison_method?
            parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)
          else
            "(#{condition.source})"
          end
        end

        def parenthesized_method_arguments(node)
          method_call = node.source_range.begin.join(node.loc.selector.end).source
          arguments = node.first_argument.source_range.begin.join(node.source_range.end).source

          "#{method_call}(#{arguments})"
        end

        def allow_modifier?
          cop_config['AllowModifier']
        end

        def outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
          node.condition.source_range.begin_pos > if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # If the branch of a conditional consists solely of a conditional node,
      # its conditions can be combined with the conditions of the outer branch.
      # This helps to keep the nesting level from getting too deep.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     if condition_b
      #       do_something
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a && condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: false (default)
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      #
      # @example AllowModifier: true
      #   # good
      #   if condition_a
      #     do_something if condition_b
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   if condition_b
      #     do_something
      #   end if condition_a
      class SoleNestedConditional < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Consider merging nested conditions into outer `%<conditional_type>s` conditions.'

        def self.autocorrect_incompatible_with
          [Style::NegatedIf, Style::NegatedUnless]
        end

        def on_if(node)
          return if node.ternary? || node.else? || node.elsif?

          if_branch = node.if_branch
          return if use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(node.condition, if_branch)
          return unless offending_branch?(node, if_branch)

          message = format(MSG, conditional_type: node.keyword)
          add_offense(if_branch.loc.keyword, message: message) do |corrector|
            autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        private

        def use_variable_assignment_in_condition?(condition, if_branch)
          assigned_variables = assigned_variables(condition)

          assigned_variables && if_branch&.if_type? &&
            assigned_variables.include?(if_branch.condition.source)
        end

        def assigned_variables(condition)
          assigned_variables = condition.assignment? ? [condition.children.first.to_s] : []

          assigned_variables + condition.descendants.select(&:assignment?).map do |node|
            node.children.first.to_s
          end
        end

        def offending_branch?(node, branch)
          return false unless branch

          branch.if_type? &&
            !branch.else? &&
            !branch.ternary? &&
            !((node.modifier_form? || branch.modifier_form?) && allow_modifier?)
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, node, if_branch)
          if node.condition.or_type? || node.condition.assignment?
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '(', ')')
          end

          if outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
            autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          else
            autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_basic(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node) if node.unless?

          outer_condition = node.condition
          correct_outer_condition(corrector, outer_condition)

          and_operator = if_branch.unless? ? ' && !' : ' && '
          if if_branch.modifier_form?
            correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          else
            correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
            correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          end
        end

        def autocorrect_outer_condition_modify_form(corrector, node, if_branch)
          correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, if_branch, is_modify_form: true) if if_branch.unless?
          correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
        end

        def correct_from_unless_to_if(corrector, node, is_modify_form: false)
          corrector.replace(node.loc.keyword, 'if')

          insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
        end

        def correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_after(outer_condition, "#{and_operator}#{replace_condition(condition)}")

          range = range_between(if_branch.loc.keyword.begin_pos, condition.source_range.end_pos)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(range, newlines: false))
          corrector.remove(if_branch.loc.keyword)
        end

        def correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)
          range = range_between(
            node.condition.source_range.end_pos, if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
          )
          corrector.replace(range, and_operator)
          corrector.remove(range_by_whole_lines(node.loc.end, include_final_newline: true))

          wrap_condition(corrector, if_branch.condition)
        end

        def wrap_condition(corrector, condition)
          # Handle `send` and `block` nodes that need to be wrapped in parens
          # FIXME: autocorrection prevents syntax errors by wrapping the entire node in parens,
          #        but wrapping the argument list would be a more ergonomic correction.
          node_to_check = condition&.any_block_type? ? condition.send_node : condition
          return unless wrap_condition?(node_to_check)

          if condition.call_type?
            source = parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)

            corrector.replace(condition, source)
          else
            corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')
          end
        end

        def correct_for_outer_condition_modify_form_style(corrector, node, if_branch)
          condition = if_branch.condition
          corrector.insert_before(condition,
                                  "#{'!' if node.unless?}#{replace_condition(node.condition)} && ")

          corrector.remove(node.condition)
          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(node.loc.keyword, newlines: false))
          corrector.replace(if_branch.loc.keyword, 'if')
        end

        def correct_for_comment(corrector, node, if_branch)
          comments = processed_source.ast_with_comments[if_branch].select do |comment|
            comment.loc.line < if_branch.condition.first_line
          end
          comment_text = comments.map(&:text).join("\n") << "\n"

          corrector.insert_before(node.loc.keyword, comment_text) unless comments.empty?
        end

        def correct_outer_condition(corrector, condition)
          return unless require_parentheses?(condition)

          end_pos = condition.loc.selector.end_pos
          begin_pos = condition.first_argument.source_range.begin_pos
          return if end_pos > begin_pos

          range = range_between(end_pos, begin_pos)
          corrector.remove(range)
          corrector.insert_after(range, '(')
          corrector.insert_after(condition.last_argument, ')')
        end

        def insert_bang(corrector, node, is_modify_form)
          condition = node.condition

          if (condition.send_type? && condition.comparison_method? && !condition.parenthesized?) ||
             (is_modify_form && wrap_condition?(condition))
            corrector.wrap(node.condition, '!(', ')')
          elsif condition.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          else
            corrector.insert_before(condition, '!')
          end
        end

        def insert_bang_for_and(corrector, node)
          lhs, rhs = *node # rubocop:disable InternalAffairs/NodeDestructuring

          if lhs.and_type?
            insert_bang_for_and(corrector, lhs)
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!') if rhs
          else
            corrector.insert_before(lhs, '!')
            corrector.insert_before(rhs, '!')
          end
        end

        def require_parentheses?(condition)
          condition.call_type? && !condition.arguments.empty? && !condition.parenthesized? &&
            !condition.comparison_method?
        end

        def wrap_condition?(node)
          node.operator_keyword? || (node.call_type? && node.arguments.any? && !node.parenthesized?)
        end

        def replace_condition(condition)
          return condition.source unless wrap_condition?(condition)

          if condition.call_type? && !condition.comparison_method?
            parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)
          else
            "(#{condition.source})"
          end
        end

        def parenthesized_method_arguments(node)
          method_call = node.source_range.begin.join(node.loc.selector.end).source
          arguments = node.first_argument.source_range.begin.join(node.source_range.end).source

          "#{method_call}(#{arguments})"
        end

        def allow_modifier?
          cop_config['AllowModifier']
        end

        def outer_condition_modify_form?(node, if_branch)
          node.condition.source_range.begin_pos > if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
